notes: Reconciles previously uncovered cast/boss skills and one metadata correction. Duplicate identities already represented by earlier batches were removed: Gigantic Ki Blast (Batch 264), Super Great Ape Beam (Batch 278), Boulder Toss and Boulder Break (Batch 283), plus Dragon Flash Bullet/Whirlwind Blade/Gigantic Slam/Final Flash/Bloody Sauce where applicable. Energy Cannon is retained as a formal correction to Batch 283. Darkness Mixer, Pretty Charge, Energy Jet, Ice Claw, and Gigantic Omega remain new research records. Giant Storm was also absent from docs/data/skills.json and is explicitly documented as a 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate obtained from the Skill Shop.
